notes.title: Celebrate pixel art with the Clockwork Ambrosia demo and a Tower Song discount!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45095080/708aaa89477a9c20186967f5b9fd9023bbc1ded8.gif[/img]

We're big fans of pixel art games here at Omega, and we know you are too! So we're super excited that both Tower Song [b]and [/b]Clockwork Ambrosia will join the PixElated Festival from 29 July - 5 August, alongside some of the best pixel art games on Steam! Whether you are looking for retro classics, like our own Tower Song, or more contemporary gems like Clockwork Ambrosa you will find it here!

Plus, there will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ - all centered around our favorite pixel art games!

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

See you there :D

notes.title: Scrapchasers: Teaser Trailer Released!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=kZzzk77CSEA;full][/previewyoutube]

We know everyone's excited for Clockwork Ambrosia (we certainly are!), but before we hit the home stretch this year we took a short detour to exercise our dev brains and prototype another little game!

The result... Scrapchasers! 

More to come! Stay tuned! (And in the meantime, feel free to wishlist the game!)
